Vendored from PortAudio master, commit d71746635dae088c5d7c808d5f29f0b939458739.
https://github.com/PortAudio/portaudio

Used only by the Windows standalone DirectSound and ASIO adapters. The native
WASAPI, CoreAudio and ALSA adapters remain in src/ui/.

Local CMake fixes:
- Compile pa_win_wdmks_utils.c for DirectSound device information even when the
  WDM-KS playback backend is disabled.
- Recognize the current ASIOSDK directory spelling on case-sensitive filesystems.

The default build does not compile or link PortAudio and needs no CMake or SDK.
`make ASIO=1` enables DirectSound and ASIO on Windows, uses `build-asio/`,
and requires CMake 3.18+. Only this opt-in build downloads Steinberg's ASIO SDK
into its build directory. The SDK is not vendored. Official CI and release
builds leave ASIO off. `scripts/package-windows.sh build-asio <dist>` includes
the GPL notice generated by that build; native-only packages omit it.
The SDK offers GPLv3 or a separately agreed proprietary license; ASIO-enabled
standalone binaries distributed without that agreement are GPLv3 builds. The
S-MU2000 and PortAudio source retain their existing licenses.
